title: I never write reviews
body:
This app is worth every dollar if you truly go with it. 
The sharing with others is great for accountability. The app is so designed that it gives dopamine getting streaks and gold screen. 
If you are looking for an app to track your habits, this is the one.

Whatever was tried there, it did not work at all…

body: Kind of disappointed in this app. The widgets don’t update until you tap on them (from both the lock screen and home screen) which defeats the purpose, and my reason for downloading in the first place!
author: lkaisjekvnke83838238

title: Nice but buggy
body:
I really want to like this app, and the design/ux is very good indeed. However there are so many bugs with sync in particular; constant double entries / deleted tasks reappear etc. And recently i have to disable notifications for my tasks every day again, because somehow for some tasks they are automatically re-enabled the next day, very annoying. 

So potentially a very good app, but please fix the bugs - now it is unusable.

author: draiiiii

title: Excellent
body:
On the Brilliant.org website they have a streaks function and I found it to be very motivating. So I wanted it for other things and went on searching. 

Very carefully made. I don’t see it often with iOS apps that even after a few hours of testing I still get surprised by some wonderful snippets of features and little hidden germs. Bought the Mac app also and goodbye Google Calendar “Goals”.. 

Edit: seriously tho; it’s a great app, just make sure you don’t torture yourself for missing a streak; just try to make the next streak bigger. Also feel free to set tasks on pause during harder times, be gracious yet encouraging.
author: OSXDEVIN

title: Great tracker, terrible UI
body:
Once everything is set up, it works great. But the UI is very strange and takes some getting used to. For example, you have three different stat views per goal you set, plus a different long press action per view. In order to rearrange, you don’t long press like on the Home Screen, you tap the six dots with an arrow? 

The design is very convoluted, but it’s not bad. It’s difficult for sure.

title: Ziet er goed uit!

title: Best habit app I’ve used
body: Tried a lot of habit apps and Strikes is the best one I’ve had. I wish I could add more habits than 12, but I can imagine why the makers limited it to 12, as more than that can also feel excessive.
